'''Sweitt Concorkill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Vurk/Legends|Vurk]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented [[Sembla/Legends|Sembla]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Sweitt began his political career when the war between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] started after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war, he attended a performance of [[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]] at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] following the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. He was present with [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] appeared to receive important information about [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] location.<ref name="Film 3">{{Film|III}}</ref> He eventually became suspicious over Palpatine's growing power and was one of the senators to join the [[Delegation of 2000]].<ref name="Who's who">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Sweitt Concorkill was among the sixty-three senators that were [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] by the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the rule of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Vurk.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Concorkill at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]].]]
{{Quote|Sweitt Concorkill was originally supposed to be an Ongree Senator, which is why the Coleman Kcaj image was used for the ROTS Visual Dictionary. The clothes were changed from Senate robes to Jedi robes and the character's name was changed to Coleman Kcaj because the CG modelers completely redid the Pablo-Jill model.|Leland Chee|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|11|Jedi High Council Roster}}</ref>}}
During production of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], the [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] seated on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] was to have been named Sweitt Concorkill. This character has now become [[Coleman Kcaj/Legends|Coleman Kcaj]].<ref name="Blog" /> In the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]] he is still mistakenly pictured as an Ongree.

Concorkill's costume is very similar, if not identical, to that to [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] at the beginning of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']].
